```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(data.table)
  library(TFBlearner)   
  library(ggplot2)
  library(PRROC)
  library(scales)   
})

set.seed(187)

SCRIPT_DIR   <- getwd()
PROJECT_ROOT <- file.path(SCRIPT_DIR, "..")
OUTPUT_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "output")

predictions <- fread(file.path(OUTPUT_DIR, "xgBoost_outputs/predictions/xgBoost_loco_n1000_LOCTO/xgBoost_loco_n1000_LOCTO.tsv"))

```

# Validate
```{r}
setDT(predictions); setkeyv(predictions, index_cols)
setDT(data);        setkeyv(data,        index_cols)
pred_eval <- data[predictions, nomatch = 0L]

pred_eval <- pred_eval[!is.na(xgBoost_probability) & !is.na(label)]
pred_eval[, method := "xgBoost"]

aupr_tf <- function(DT, score_col = "xgBoost_probability", label_col = "label") {
  if (length(unique(DT[[label_col]])) < 2L) return(NA_real_)
  res <- TFBlearner:::.getPRCurve(
    DT,
    scores    = score_col,
    labels    = label_col,
    posClass  = 1,
    negClass  = 0,
    aggregate = TRUE,
    models    = "method",
    seed      = 187
  )
  res$auc_pr_mod
}

aupr_global <- aupr_tf(pred_eval)
cat(sprintf("Global AUPR (TFBlearner): %.4f\n", aupr_global))

by_ct_list <- lapply(split(pred_eval, pred_eval$celltype), aupr_tf)
aupr_by_ct <- data.table(
  celltype = names(by_ct_list),
  auc_pr   = as.numeric(by_ct_list)
)[order(celltype)]

by_chr_list <- lapply(split(pred_eval, pred_eval$chr), aupr_tf)
aupr_by_chr <- data.table(
  chr    = names(by_chr_list),
  auc_pr = as.numeric(by_chr_list)
)[order(chr)]

```

```{r}
setDT(pred_eval)
pred_eval <- pred_eval[!is.na(xgBoost_probability) & !is.na(label)]

# positives / negatives
pos <- pred_eval[label == 1, xgBoost_probability]
neg <- pred_eval[label == 0, xgBoost_probability]

# PRROC-native curve (smooth) + AUPR
pr <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = TRUE)
aupr     <- pr$auc.integral
baseline <- mean(pred_eval$label == 1)

# curve points
pr_df <- data.frame(recall = pr$curve[,1], precision = pr$curve[,2])

# (optional) thin to ≤1000 points for cleaner rendering without changing shape
if (nrow(pr_df) > 1000) {
  keep <- round(seq(1, nrow(pr_df), length.out = 1000))
  pr_df <- pr_df[keep, , drop = FALSE]
}

# annotation label (no Lift)
ann_txt <- sprintf("AUPR = %.3f\nBaseline = %.3f", aupr, baseline)

ggplot(pr_df, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
  # shade improvement over baseline
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = baseline, ymax = pmax(precision, baseline)), alpha = 0.12) +
  # original PRROC curve (do not switch to step)
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = baseline, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_label(aes(x = 0.02, y = 0.98, label = ann_txt),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label.size = 0, size = 3.4, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.001, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.001, 0)) +
  labs(title = "xgBoost Precision–Recall (LOCTO)",
       x = "Recall", y = "Precision") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.15),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 9)
  )
```



```{r}
setDT(pred_eval)

# --- Build PR curves per cell type (PRROC-native; DO NOT alter precision) ---
get_pr_df <- function(dt) {
  if (length(unique(dt$label)) < 2L) return(NULL)
  pos <- dt$xgBoost_probability[dt$label == 1]
  neg <- dt$xgBoost_probability[dt$label == 0]
  pr  <- PRROC::pr.curve(scores.class0 = pos, scores.class1 = neg, curve = TRUE)
  data.table(
    recall    = pr$curve[,1],
    precision = pr$curve[,2],
    AUPR      = pr$auc.integral,
    celltype  = unique(dt$celltype)[1]
  )
}

curves <- rbindlist(lapply(split(pred_eval, pred_eval$celltype), get_pr_df), fill = TRUE)
stopifnot(nrow(curves) > 0)

# Baseline (prevalence) per cell type & merge into curves so all layers can access
baselines <- pred_eval[, .(baseline = mean(label == 1)), by = celltype]
curves <- merge(curves, baselines, by = "celltype", all.x = TRUE)

# One annotation row per facet
ann_df <- unique(curves[, .(celltype, AUPR, baseline)])
# --- annotations: no Lift, slightly lower placement ---
ann_df <- unique(curves[, .(celltype, AUPR, baseline)])
ann_df[, `:=`(
  label_txt = sprintf("AUPR = %.3f\nBaseline = %.3f", AUPR, baseline),
  x = 0.02,
  y = 0.96
)]

# --- plot: smaller fonts/lines, lighter shading ---
ggplot(curves, aes(x = recall, y = precision)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = baseline, ymax = pmax(precision, baseline)), alpha = 0.12) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.7) +                                   # thinner curve
  geom_hline(data = unique(curves[, .(celltype, baseline)]),
             aes(yintercept = baseline), linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_label(data = ann_df,
             aes(x = x, y = y, label = label_txt),
             hjust = 0, vjust = 1, label.size = 0, size = 3.2) + # smaller label
  facet_wrap(~ celltype) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.001, 0)) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1),
                     limits = c(0, 1), expand = c(0.001, 0)) +
  labs(title = "xgBoost Precision–Recall by Cell Type (LOCTO)",
       x = "Recall", y = "Precision") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +                                # smaller base font
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.15),
    strip.text       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    axis.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    axis.text        = element_text(size = 9),
    panel.spacing    = grid::unit(0.8, "lines")
  )

```
